paragraphs: DIMS sells case management software for specialty and treatment courts. It also sells cloud-based probation and pretrial software for managing clients, supervising cases and running risk assessments. Drug testing is the third piece, offered as one digital solution with laboratory information management for instrument or instant testing.

Participant data sits on a platform the company describes as HIPAA compliant, with visual analytics and reporting. The pieces are vertically integrated with case management, lab information systems and accounting platforms so that people and resources are not entered twice. A digital cup product is described as improving the accuracy of reported results and removing errors in data delivery. Alcohol testing runs through a portable breathalyzer paired to the client's phone over Bluetooth. Automated notifications remind participants to check in and submit a photo for verification. Each check-in carries a timestamp and geo-tag recording where the participant was at the moment of submission.

The company says courts in 46 states use the system. Versions are customized for different court types, from adult treatment courts to DUI courts. It states that there are no long term contracts. The product is presented as designed by justice professionals for treatment court needs.
